scope: Exploratory allocation-criterion audit on two development sequences, not hypothesis confirmation or efficiency evidence

counterfactual.rule: For each dense-matched but missed target on scheduled frames, restore its omitted dense-anchor site and remove the lowest-scored selected site at the same scale; log unsuccessful restorations

interpretation_limits: Dense head outputs are computed everywhere, then subset before NMS; this is an offline criterion intervention, not saved execution.
The GEN1-trained detector is not adapted to DSEC; report dense detectability and domain limitation.
Fixed confidence does not establish equal FPPI; report achieved FPPI and withhold H1/H2/H3 verdicts.
No importance/hybrid implementation, no calibrated trust probability, no formal preregistration.
No age priority or tracks in allocation: this isolates the score, not the complete deployment policy.
The small-object split is descriptive, not a matched causal critical/ordinary comparison.
Two sequences and one checkpoint do not support generalization confidence intervals.
Ground-truth-aided exchanges are immediate diagnostics, not deployable corrections or restored temporal runs.
